title: Vapouriz Premium USA Gold Tobacco E-Liquid 10ml
description: An all-American classic gets an e-liquid makeover in this endlessly satisfying tobacco vape from Vapouriz. A delightful tobacco blend, with a light, subtle sweetness on the inhale, followed by a rich, smooth, slightly nutty note on the exhale. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
